Text:
# SEPTIC BURSITIS

Obtain synovial fluid for gram stain and culture to guide therapy.


## _______________________________________________________________________________

References:
Up-to-date website
Sanford keyword: Bursitis, septic
Mandell chapter: Infectious arthritis of native joints
Baumbach SF, Arch Orthop Trauma Surg 2014, 134:359
Therapy:
## Inpatient

## Likely MSSA:

Cefazolin 2 gm IV q8h 

## Likey MRSA:

Beta-lactam Reaction Assessment
Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h 

## Step down to oral therapy

Likely MSSA:
Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h 
Likely MRSA:
Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID 
< OR >
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO BID 

## Outpatient

## Mild cases in otherwise healthy adults

Likely MSSA:
Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h ($) for 14 days
Likely MRSA:
Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID for 14 days
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO BID for 14 days

## Moderate to severe cases

Refer to Inpatient guidance above.
